findings.text: the reported bank-overflow count is the count of non-finite per-cell currents, summed into total_overflow and reprinted as nonfinite_cell_current_signatures at run_census.py:57, so the done_when's two terminal readings are one instrument and the zero-overflow verdict carries no information the finite-total verdict does not.
the pin block is edited outside the run's declared write paths, so the landed diff leaves its declared scope even though the manifest states coordinator direction for the edit.

the commits field names only the two repair commits and not the five commits of the pass this run landed (87d11db6c, abd30a39b, 4b7b59ad6, 5840fcd44, 237e3e931), so the manifest alone does not cover the reviewed range.

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that _partition_probe hands the whole state vector to operator._fixed_design_read, and benchmarks/unit_amplitude_current_census.py:304 now passes jnp.asarray(state) un-sliced, which census-after-bank-repair/negative-control.log:3-4 shows as full_state_rows=772 against physical_node_number=256.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, its test line records the cache-guard wall-clock-reliable 3 passed in 161.63 s at 247e5aa4a, and its negative_control_log resolves on disk, but its commits line at manifest.md:11 names only the two repair commits.

justifications.evidence: the census, negative-control and gate logs are committed and green, but docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/census-after-bank-repair/run_census.py:32 reads the bank overflow count off the same per-cell non-finite test reprinted as nonfinite_cell_current_signatures at run_census.py:57, and the exact total lands at 0.859 of the analytic target without the run separating the two changes that moved it.
justifications.fit: the widening follows the module idiom and its docstring at benchmarks/unit_amplitude_current_census.py:296-302 states the constraint, introducing no name the repository rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: benchmarks/unit_amplitude_current_census.py:304 passes jnp.asarray(state) un-sliced into operator._fixed_design_read, and census-after-bank-repair/negative-control.log:3 records full_state_rows=772 against physical_node_number=256.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the head diff is inside the manifest's declared paths except tests/test_outboard_hole_census_gate.py:121 and the reverted plan-version meta at docs/plans/cut-cell-current-attribution.html:29, which now reads 192.
